chunks: And Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from some of our companions, from one of the two Imams عليهما السلام:
Regarding a man who broke another man’s hand, and then the man’s hand healed, he عليه السلام said: “There is no qisas in this case, but he must give al-arsh.”

key_terms.الْأَرْشَ: financial compensation assessed for an injury
key_terms.كَسَرَ يَدَ رَجُلٍ: causing a fracture to another man’s hand

ai.seo_question: If someone breaks another person’s hand and it later heals, is qisas applied or only financial compensation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury when a broken hand later heals. It states that qisas does not apply in such a case, but financial compensation in the form of al-arsh is still due.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5393 - Jameel ibn Darraj narrated from some of our companions from one of the two Imams (as) regarding a man who broke another man's hand, and then the man's hand healed.
Imam (as) said: "There is no retaliation (qisas) in this case, but he must pay compensation (Al-arsh)."
